captions.detailed: A sleek, tall tower air purifier with a light gray matte finish and a stable black base. It features a slotted rear access door with a small black handle, which swings open on a side hinge to reveal a dark, pull-out filter cartridge. The top surface hosts a black control panel with four small cylindrical buttons (one green and three gray) that can be depressed independently.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a tower air purifier with a light gray body and a black base. It must feature a rear access door with horizontal ventilation slots that rotates open, a dark-colored filter cartridge inside that slides out, and a top control panel with four small cylindrical buttons (one green, three gray) that can be individually depressed.
captions.factory: Construct the main body as a rounded box extrusion with a black base plate. Create the rear access door by extruding a thin plate, adding horizontal slot cuts, and attaching a small black handle. Model the internal filter cartridge as a dark rectangular block. For the top control panel, create a recessed black plate and generate four small cylinders for the buttons, assigning one a green material and the others gray.
